newsitem.title: USA: Network Event Theater Q3 shr loss $0.17.
newsitem.headline: Network Event Theater Q3 shr loss $0.17.

text.p: Network Event Theater Inc reported a net loss of $1.45 million, or $0.17 per share, for the fiscal third quarter ended March 31, 1997, on revenues of $2.27 million.
Excluding the effect of the purchase of Campus Voice, the company said its net loss for the period would have been $0.15 per share.
For the first nine months of fiscal 1997, revenues totaled $4.94 million, with a loss of $3.1 million or $0.36 per share.
The company did not provide comparative results for 1996.
